description: AICTIONBOT™ deadline guard by KULIC Advisory. From contract start, initial term, automatic renewal and notice period it calculates the current term end, the last day notice must reach the other party, the days left and what happens if the date is missed. Deterministic, no AI. Not legal advice: the wording of the contract decides.

contract_start.description: First day of the contract, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

notice_period.description: Notice period before the end of the term: number plus unit d (days), w (weeks) or m (months), e.g. 3m.

renewal_months.description: Automatic renewal period in months after the initial term; 0 if the contract ends without renewal. Default 12.

today.description: Optional reference date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (Europe/Berlin).

name: calculate_notice_deadline
title: Calculate the last day to give notice on a contract
